workPackages.notes: Agent side. PsutilHardwareProbe implements the §10.2 HardwareProbe port (all fields nullable — /proc/cpuinfo fallback for CPU model on Linux); NvmlGpuProbe optional per §21.2 (import/init failure → no fabricated GPU entries); CompositeHardwareProbe degrades each part independently. §10.5 timeout bounds the WAIT via asyncio.wait (worker threads are uncancellable — abandoned past deadline, late result discarded). /device: Bearer + models:read (§13.2 API table), lan_addresses reuse §16.2 interface selection, tailnet block mirrors WP-14 probe, gpus [] when none detected (no invented null-GPU). workPackages.title: POST /models/load|unload (API-MODEL-02/03) + §16.5 keep-warm scheduler
workPackages.notes: Agent side — completes the Agent-side M5 scope. load/unload: Bearer + models:manage, 202 {"state":"loading"} verbatim (unload mirrors 'unloaded' — QUESTION-106), 404 MODEL_NOT_FOUND via Router.resolve, 501 UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY from the §10.2 base contract (Ollama has no explicit load, §10.3), 422 INVALID_REQUEST allow-list body; no rate limit added (§13.8 exhaustive). KeepWarmScheduler (§16.5): warm set ONLY from models.overrides[].keep_warm, interval = min(idle_unload/2, 240 s) [DESIGN idle=300s per §6.2], keep_warm-capable backends only (Ollama native ping; LM Studio n/a), gated on ≥1 non-revoked device active in 60 min — never warms silently; failures degrade to allow-listed logs (CI-21 mitigation); injectable clock; §10.6 startup order + symmetric stop. Fake Ollama: server-level in-memory state + warm-ping counter (observable via /api/ps). Real-process smoke over the TLS token path: 202/404/501/422/401 + fake state flip observed

gates.detail: 315 collected — 312 passed + 3 announced skips (incl. 3 TC-SEC-10 TLS handshake entries + 3 CI-21 keep-warm chain entries + 3 CI-18/21 cold-load e2e entries + 5 §10.3 rule-4 stream-budget units + 3 TC-SEC-05 fuzz entries + lifespan warning-pin + 19 hardware-probe units); suite emits ZERO warnings since the lifespan migration

gates.name: SSE stream robustness — cold-load pings + §10.3 rule-4 budgets (CI-18/21)
gates.detail: FIXED this round: the API layer hard-aborted the first token at 30 s with an uncaught TimeoutError (stream died WITHOUT mesh.error — NFR-REL-02 violation) and the adapter applied the 60 s idle budget to the first-token gap. Now: `: ping` every 15 s until the first token (§13.7 'pings until first token', CI-21 mitigation), first-token gap budgeted at first_token_timeout_seconds (120 s, Appendix E — now actually wired from config), post-first-chunk gaps at 60 s, expiry → terminal mesh.error BACKEND_TIMEOUT (504 retryable); cold-load e2e over the real app + fake backend asserts pings + terminal error + no [DONE]

gates.name: TC-SEC-05 unauth fuzz of every endpoint (§17.13 L5)
gates.detail: repeatable deterministic battery (no random corpus) enumerated from the app's OWN OpenAPI schema — 12 public routes × 4 auth variants × 7 body variants + admin listener (forged Host → 403, missing/wrong X-Admin-Token → 401): never a 5xx, §13.4 envelope everywhere, no attacker-input reflection, no stack traces, X-Mesh-Request-Id always present; route-set pinned so new endpoints must join the fuzz

gates.name: App lifecycle = single FastAPI lifespan (§10.6)
gates.detail: deprecated @app.on_event decorators removed (they emitted 228 suite-wide DeprecationWarnings); startup/shutdown symmetry preserved; factory pinned warning-free by test (DeprecationWarning ⇒ error)

gates.name: TC-SEC-10 TLS 1.3-only scan (§17.13)
gates.detail: repeatable pytest entry with REAL handshakes against the production context builder (security.tls.build_tls13_server_context): TLS 1.3 client negotiates TLSv1.3 + 1.3 cipher suite; TLS 1.2-only client rejected closed on BOTH sides; minimum_version pinned to TLSv1_3

gates.name: CI-21 chain: keep-warm × mesh.meta (§16.5 · §13.7)
gates.detail: cold chat pins model_state=unloaded at meta-emission time (demand-load still completes); after one §16.5 tick with an active device + registry refresh, the next chat emits model_state=loaded (fake /api/ps → §10.3 state derivation); baseline in-memory model reads loaded
